title: ReplayResponse
description: The canonical replay reconstruction authority contract. Emitted by the Replay Engine in response to a replay request. Establishes deterministic reconstruction authority (Constitutional Law One). The UI replay slider must request a certified state snapshot at a given sequence_id from this schema — it must never filter or reconstruct events locally.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this replay session. All AuthoritativeEvents emitted during this session carry this session_id.

requested_sequence_id.description: The sequence_id cursor position requested by the observer. The Replay Engine reconstructs state as of this event. This is the backend-authoritative replay cursor — the UI slider maps to this field.

certification_state.description: Replay Engine certification of this reconstruction. CERTIFIED = deterministic replay confirmed. DEGRADED = minor data gaps, replay valid with caveats. PARTIAL = incomplete event window, replay approximate. INVALID = replay cannot be certified. UI must render this field directly — it must never compute certification client-side.

certification_reason.description: Optional. Human-readable explanation of certification_state when not CERTIFIED. Backend-emitted — UI renders verbatim.

reconstructed_at_ns.description: Nanosecond timestamp at which the Replay Engine performed this reconstruction. Establishes reconstruction provenance.

first_sequence_id.description: sequence_id of the first event in this replay window.

last_sequence_id.description: sequence_id of the last event in this replay window.

event_count.description: Total number of events in this window. UI must not count events independently.

events.description: Ordered array of AuthoritativeEvents in this replay window. Ordered by sequence_id ascending. UI renders in this order — no client-side sorting or filtering.

portfolio_state.description: Certified portfolio state as reconstructed at requested_sequence_id. All values are backend-computed.

causal_chain.description: Optional. Backend-certified causal ancestry chain for the event at requested_sequence_id. Each entry is a sequence_id of an ancestor event. UI must not derive causal relationships independently — this field is the sole source of causal truth.

replay_signature.description: SHA-256 hex digest of (session_id + strategy_id + requested_sequence_id + certification_state + event_window.event_count). Enables Law One audit for replay surfaces.
